_about: A staged board for ghost_trails.py --board. bodies are [card, x, y, team] where each troop stands --lead seconds BEFORE the decision (the engine plays the lead); team 0 is ours, at the bottom. towers are [King, left Princess, right Princess] HP fractions per team. elixir is [ours, theirs] at the decision. plays are [card, x, y], or [card, "aim"] for a spell to go where it does the most damage, or [card, "net"] for the cell the network prefers for that card; the network's own pick is always added at its own cell.
_found: Found by a random search over staged triple-elixir boards (sudden death). Kept because, played out to the end from the frozen board (the network sampling for us, 16 games per move), the lookahead's pick really wins: Fireball 25/32, Hog Rider (the network's pick) 3/32, Cannon 5/32, Ice Spirit 0/32, doing nothing 3/32.
title: Triple elixir
